subject: your customers' card fees
body:
Hi Greg,

Saw Coastline Restaurant Supply already partners with a few vendors for your customers.

A lot of those owners are overpaying on card processing and don't know it. I do free statement reviews. When one of your customers switches, you get a share of the revenue for as long as they stay. You don't sell anything, you just make the intro.

Open to a 15 minute call to see if it fits?

Joaquin
Call script: ask how many merchant customers they serve monthly and whether anyone asks them about payments. Offer a one page referral card they can hand out.

subject: the one pager
body:
Greg, one more thought. Partners usually start by sending me the one customer who complains about fees the most. If the review saves them money, you look good and you get paid. Want me to send over the one pager?

Joaquin

subject: quick question, Dave
body:
Hi Dave,

Saw your post about card fees eating into margin. That one comes up a lot with auto shop owners in San Pedro.

Do you know your effective rate, all fees in, divided by what you processed last month? Most owners guess low by about a point. I can work it out from one statement and send it back the same day.

Joaquin

subject: one photo is enough
body:
Dave, the fastest version: snap a photo of page one of your statement and reply here. I'll send back your effective rate and where the extra is coming from.

Joaquin

subject: closing the loop
body:
